description: Sixteen evidence-rich pilots for the first Research Factory cycle. Pinning affects production order only; it does not assert quality or readiness.

title_contains_any: Auditing Score Exposure and Presentation Order
pilots.reason: Current source has a local claim ledger, verified citations, deterministic analysis and an arXiv build history; it is the best first end-to-end package audit.

title_contains_any: Reading a Leaderboard Before You Cite It
pilots.reason: A complete package exists, but the independent review identified conceptual-validity blockers that must be resolved before the package can be called ready.
The paper has a strong bounded audit case, but the project lacks a Research Factory overlay and must bind its claim ledger, statistical interpretation and package receipt to the current source.

title_contains_any: Your Tool-Selection Benchmark May Be Scoring Wrong Calls as Correct
pilots.reason: The public evidence kit, replay, fresh cross-model probe and Kaggle receipt exist; the local Markdown is an older source version and must be reconciled before drafting an arXiv source.
The first overlay is already established, but source identity, the official scoring methodology and the arXiv package remain blocked.
The canonical source has 176 frozen numerical carriers and a deterministic package, but proof, held-out, drift-evidence, T7 and independent-review gates remain open.

The canonical source, carrier receipts, citation set and package are bound, but the 1,200-cell raw JSONL files and complete evidence manifest are missing; aggregate findings remain candidate and the review remains open.

title_contains_any: An Empirical Study of Aggregation Methods Under Verifier Capture
pilots.reason: The synthetic benchmark, local pilot, carrier receipt and package are bound, but the S4 result contradicts the native all-scenario majority claim and held-out, hyperparameter and universal-result gates remain blocked.

The arXiv identity exists, but the archived driver realizes only 1,200 of the printed 2,400 rounds, the two controls and per-seed result file are absent, and the merge target classifies P9 as a protocol deposit. The correct disposition is merge/archive, not an independent package.

The source is converted from a claimed TEE mitigation into a bounded reproducibility failure analysis. Simulation gamma means, carrier rows and compilation reproduce; CV is not recoverable from seeds, the real API is parser-degenerate, model identity is absent, and the 39.2 percent scalar belongs to a separate calibration contrast.

title_contains_any: Conditional Communication Effects in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
pilots.reason: The current paper13 canonical source is structurally clean and uses the reproducible balanced ANOVA, but Face-1 CAF and the GPT-4o temporal decomposition lack raw carriers, the stored ANOVA block is not derivable from its sessions, the old source mirror carries legacy values, and review remains open. The correct disposition is blocked, not package.

title_contains_any: Memory Architecture Effects on Output-Length Responses
pilots.reason: The R1 per-seed grid, v4-flash rebuild and Round-4 aggregate are recomputable, but the source needed template cleanup, authority markers are not validated authority bias, Round-4 raw logs are aggregate-only, and independent review remains open. The overlay is an internal candidate package, not upload authorization.

The central 2700-cell archive is a declaration rather than a sample, the per-seed files disagree, the real-LLM subset is incomplete, and p16/p18/p21 lack field-level carriers. The correct disposition is blocked, not package.

The 270-cell pilot and bibliography recompute, but the 18,000-trial, 2,700-hold and 192/144/90/40 headlines lack carriers; four F4 rows, the manifest, carrier gate, baselines and author metadata do not reconcile. The correct disposition is blocked, not package.

The canonical source is explicitly deprecated and asks not to be submitted or repackaged. The named tmlr_p12 target contains none of the study terms, four arXiv copies use a different dataset scope, E6 contradicts the four-class headline, and 42 of 201 carrier receipts have no verdict. The correct disposition is merge/archive, not package.

The canonical side shell is explicitly deprecated and cannot be submitted, uploaded or repackaged independently. The named p12 target shares N-sensitivity vocabulary but none of the study data, models or result carriers; the six-class synthetic scope conflicts with the eight-class Newsgroups snapshot, printed AUROC/Brier values do not match the snapshot, only 10 of 15 corrected tests survive, and 42 of 57 mechanical carrier PASS receipts are semantically misbound. The correct disposition is merge/archive, not package.
